source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל־לְךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְכָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Cut two new tablets out of stone, like the first pair. On them I will write the same words that stood on the first tablets, which you smashed.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "Cut two more stone tablets like the first ones. I will write on them what was written on the first tablets, which you broke to pieces.

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «Talla para ti dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y escribiré sobre las tablas las palabras que había sobre las primeras tablas, que tú rompiste.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Labra en piedra dos tablas nuevas, iguales a las primeras. En ellas escribiré las mismas palabras que estaban en las primeras tablas, las que hiciste pedazos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Corta otras dos tablas de piedra como las primeras. Yo escribiré en ellas lo que estaba escrito en las primeras tablas, las que rompiste en pedazos.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Taille-toi deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et j’écrirai sur les tables les paroles qui étaient sur les premières tables, que tu as brisées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Taille dans la pierre deux nouvelles tables, pareilles aux premières. J’y écrirai les mêmes paroles que celles qui figuraient sur les premières tables, celles que tu as fracassées.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Taille encore deux tables de pierre comme les premières. J’écrirai dessus ce qui était écrit sur les premières tables, celles que tu as cassées en morceaux.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Jichongee vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaandika juu ya vibao maneno yaliyokuwa juu ya vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Chonga vibao viwili vipya vya mawe, sawa na vile vya kwanza. Juu yake nitaandika maneno yale yale yaliyokuwa kwenye vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunjavunja.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Chonga vibao vingine viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza. Nitaandika juu yake yale yaliyoandikwa kwenye vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja vipande vipande.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 깎아 만들어라. 그러면 네가 깨뜨린 처음 판에 있던 말들을 내가 그 판에 쓰겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 말씀하셨다. "처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 새로 깎아 만들어라. 네가 깨뜨려 버린 처음 돌판에 있던 그 말들을 내가 거기에 다시 쓰겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 말씀하셨다. "처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 다시 깎아 만들어라. 네가 깨뜨려 산산조각 낸 처음 돌판에 쓰여 있던 것을 내가 거기에 다시 쓰겠다.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se: "Hãy đục cho ngươi hai bảng đá giống như [hai bảng] trước, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ viết trên các bảng ấy những lời đã có trên các bảng trước mà ngươi đã đập vỡ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se: "Hãy đục hai bảng đá mới giống như hai bảng trước. Ta sẽ viết trên đó chính những lời đã có trên hai bảng trước mà con đã đập vỡ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Môi-se: "Hãy đục thêm hai bảng đá giống như hai bảng trước. Ta sẽ viết lên đó những lời đã viết trên hai bảng trước mà con đã đập vỡ tan.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Moisés: "Talha para ti duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e eu escreverei nas tábuas as palavras que estavam nas primeiras tábuas, que quebraste.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Moisés: "Talha duas tábuas novas de pedra, iguais às primeiras. Nelas escreverei as mesmas palavras que estavam nas primeiras tábuas, que despedaçaste.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse a Moisés: "Corta mais duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras. Vou escrever nelas o que estava escrito nas primeiras tábuas, que quebraste em pedaços.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፦ «እንደ ፊተኞቹ ያሉ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ለራስህ ጥረብ፤ በሰበርካቸው በፊተኞቹ ጽላቶች ላይ የነበሩትን ቃሎች በጽላቶቹ ላይ እጽፋለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፦ «እንደ መጀመሪያዎቹ ያሉ ሁለት አዳዲስ ጽላቶችን ከድንጋይ ጥረብ። አንተ በሰባበርካቸው በመጀመሪያዎቹ ጽላቶች ላይ የነበሩትን እነዚያኑ ቃሎች በእነርሱ ላይ እጽፋለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፦ «እንደ መጀመሪያዎቹ ያሉ ሌሎች ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ጥረብ። አንተ ሰባብረሃቸው በነበሩት በመጀመሪያዎቹ ጽላቶች ላይ የተጻፈውን በእነርሱ ላይ እጽፋለሁ።

decisions.choice: which you broke: the first tablets, smashed at the foot of the mountain
decisions.reason: Moses broke the first tablets when he saw the golden calf (32:19). Those tablets were "the work of God" (32:16); now Moses must cut the stone himself, but God will again do the writing.

decisions.choice: I will write: God himself renews the broken covenant
decisions.reason: After Israel's sin with the calf, God does not hand the covenant over to be rewritten by a man. He promises to write the same words again (Deuteronomy 10:1-4). Compare verse 28, where the one who writes is less clear.

decisions.choice: smashed
decisions.reason: The verb means to break in pieces, as in 32:19. Balanced says "smashed"; Literal keeps "broke".

decisions.choice: dit (L, B); a dit (R)
decisions.reason: Narration is in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced, the tense of written narrative, and in the passé composé at Readable, as French is read in school today (docs/french-style.md section 3). Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: tables de pierre
decisions.reason: "Tables de pierre" is the established French wording for the tablets of the covenant, used throughout this translation (24:12; 2 Corinthians 3:3); the context makes plain that they are stone slabs to write on, not furniture.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The English capitalises pronouns for God as a reader setting in this chapter; the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the Amharic has nothing for the setting to change and carries no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "ጽላት" (pl. "ጽላቶች") for the stone tablets
decisions.reason: "ጽላት" is the word the Amharic New Testament uses for the tablets of the covenant (Hebrews 9:4) and the living church word for them; "ሰሌዳ" would suggest a board or slate.

source.text: וֶהְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָלִ֤יתָ בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛י שָׁ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And be prepared for the morning, and you will go up in the morning to [the] mountain of Sinai, and you will station yourself for me there on [the] top of the mountain.

en.L: And be ready for the morning, and go up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and station yourself there for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the top of the mountain.
en.B: Be prepared for the morning. When it comes, climb Mount Sinai and take your place before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on its summit.
en.R: Be ready early tomorrow morning. Then climb Mount Sinai and meet {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} there at the top.

es.L: Y prepárate para la mañana, y sube por la mañana al monte Sinaí, y apóstate allí para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la cumbre del monte.
es.B: Prepárate para la mañana. Cuando llegue, sube al monte Sinaí y preséntate ante {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en su cumbre.
es.R: Prepárate para mañana temprano. Sube al monte Sinaí y encuéntrate conmigo allí arriba, en la cima.

fr.L: Et sois prêt pour le matin, et monte au matin sur le mont Sinaï, et poste-toi là pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur le sommet de la montagne.
fr.B: Sois prêt pour le matin. Au matin, gravis le mont Sinaï et prends place devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} au sommet.
fr.R: Sois prêt demain de bonne heure. Monte alors sur le mont Sinaï et viens {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rencontrer là-haut, au sommet.

sw.L: Na uwe tayari kwa asubuhi, ukapande asubuhi hadi mlima Sinai, ujisimamishe huko kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya kilele cha mlima.
sw.B: Uwe tayari asubuhi. Ikifika, panda mlima Sinai, usimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kileleni mwake.
sw.R: Uwe tayari kesho asubuhi na mapema. Kisha panda mlima Sinai uje kukutana {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} huko juu kileleni.

ko.L: 그리고 아침까지 준비하고 있다가, 아침에 시내 산으로 올라와 거기 산꼭대기에서 내 앞에 서 있어라.
ko.B: 아침까지 준비를 마쳐라. 아침이 되면 시내 산으로 올라와, 산꼭대기에서 내 앞에 서 있어라.
ko.R: 내일 아침 일찍 준비하고 있다가 시내 산으로 올라오너라. 산꼭대기에서 나를 만나자.

vi.L: Hãy sẵn sàng cho buổi sáng, và sáng mai hãy đi lên núi Si-na-i, và đứng chờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tại đó trên đỉnh núi.
vi.B: Hãy chuẩn bị sẵn sàng cho sáng mai. Sáng mai con hãy lên núi Si-na-i và trình diện {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên đỉnh núi.
vi.R: Sáng sớm mai con hãy sẵn sàng. Rồi hãy leo lên núi Si-na-i và gặp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên đỉnh núi.

pt.L: E fica pronto para a manhã, e sobe de manhã ao monte Sinai, e põe-te ali diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} no alto do monte.
pt.B: Prepara-te para amanhã cedo. Pela manhã, sobe o monte Sinai e apresenta-te diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} no alto dele.
pt.R: Fica pronto bem cedo amanhã. Depois sobe o monte Sinai e encontra-te {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} lá no alto.

am.L: ለጠዋትም ተዘጋጅ፤ በጠዋትም ወደ ሲና ተራራ ውጣ፤ በዚያም በተራራው ራስ ላይ በፊቴ ቁም።
am.B: ለጠዋቱ ተዘጋጅ። በነጋም ጊዜ ወደ ሲና ተራራ ውጣ፤ በተራራውም ጫፍ ላይ በፊቴ ቁም።
am.R: ነገ ማለዳ ተዘጋጅ። ከዚያም ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጥተህ በዚያ በተራራው ጫፍ ላይ ተገናኘኝ።

decisions.choice: station yourself: take a stand and wait, ready to meet God
decisions.reason: The verb means to take up a position and stand firm. God used it in 33:21 ("you shall stand on the rock"), where he promised to show Moses his glory. Here Moses is to wait for God to meet him.

decisions.choice: go up in the morning to Mount Sinai: a second ascent, like the first
decisions.reason: As in 19:20 and 24:12-18, Moses goes up the mountain to receive the tablets. This time he goes up alone (verse 3).

decisions.choice: meet me
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what taking a stand before God is for: meeting him.

source.text: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־אִ֥ישׁ אַל־יֵרָ֖א בְּכָל־הָהָ֑ר גַּם־הַצֹּ֤אן וְהַבָּקָר֙ אַל־יִרְע֔וּ אֶל־מ֖וּל הָהָ֥ר הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And anyone not he will go up with you, and also anyone not let him be seen on all the mountain; also the sheep and the cattle not let them graze to [the] front of the mountain, that [one].

en.L: And no one shall go up with you, and also let no one be seen on all the mountain; also the flocks and the herds, let them not graze in front of that mountain."
en.B: Nobody is to climb with you, and nobody else may be seen anywhere on the mountain. Keep even the flocks and herds from grazing near the front of that mountain."
en.R: No one may come up with you. No one may be anywhere on the mountain. Do not even let sheep or cattle eat grass near the mountain."

es.L: Y nadie subirá contigo, y tampoco se deje ver nadie en todo el monte; tampoco el ganado menor y el ganado mayor, que no pasten frente a aquel monte.»
es.B: Nadie ha de subir contigo, y nadie más puede dejarse ver en ninguna parte del monte. No permitas siquiera que las ovejas, las cabras y las vacas pasten delante de ese monte.»
es.R: Nadie puede subir contigo. Nadie puede estar en ninguna parte del monte. Ni siquiera dejes que las ovejas o las vacas coman hierba cerca del monte.»

fr.L: Et personne ne montera avec toi, et que personne non plus ne soit vu sur toute la montagne ; même le petit et le gros bétail, qu’ils ne paissent pas en face de cette montagne-là. »
fr.B: Personne ne doit monter avec toi, et personne d’autre ne doit se montrer nulle part sur la montagne. Ne laisse pas même le petit et le gros bétail paître devant cette montagne. »
fr.R: Personne ne doit monter avec toi. Personne ne doit se trouver sur la montagne, à aucun endroit. Ne laisse même pas les moutons ou les vaches brouter près de la montagne. »

sw.L: Na mtu yeyote asipande pamoja nawe, wala mtu yeyote asionekane katika mlima wote; hata kondoo na ng'ombe wasilishe mbele ya mlima ule."
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asipande pamoja nawe, na mtu mwingine yeyote asionekane popote mlimani. Hata makundi ya kondoo, mbuzi na ng'ombe yasilishe karibu na upande wa mbele wa mlima huo."
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asije pamoja nawe. Mtu yeyote asiwe mahali popote mlimani. Usiache hata kondoo au ng'ombe kula majani karibu na mlima huo."

ko.L: 아무도 너와 함께 올라오지 말고, 온 산 어디에서도 아무도 보이지 않게 하여라. 양 떼와 소 떼도 그 산 앞에서 풀을 뜯지 못하게 하여라."
ko.B: 아무도 너와 함께 올라와서는 안 된다. 산 어디에서도 다른 사람이 보여서는 안 된다. 양 떼와 소 떼도 그 산 앞쪽에서 풀을 뜯지 못하게 하여라."
ko.R: 아무도 너와 함께 올라오면 안 된다. 산 위 어디에도 사람이 있으면 안 된다. 양이나 소도 산 가까이에서 풀을 뜯지 못하게 해야 한다."

vi.L: Không ai được đi lên với ngươi, cũng đừng để ai bị thấy trên khắp núi; cả chiên dê và bò cũng không được ăn cỏ trước núi ấy."
vi.B: Không ai được lên núi với con, và cũng không được để ai xuất hiện ở bất cứ chỗ nào trên núi. Ngay cả chiên dê và bò cũng không được ăn cỏ gần phía trước núi ấy."
vi.R: Không ai được đi lên với con. Không ai được có mặt ở bất cứ chỗ nào trên núi. Cũng đừng để chiên dê hay bò ăn cỏ gần núi."

pt.L: E ninguém subirá contigo, e também ninguém seja visto em todo o monte; também as ovelhas e o gado não pastem em frente daquele monte."
pt.B: Ninguém subirá contigo, e ninguém mais poderá ser visto em parte alguma do monte. Não deixes nem mesmo as ovelhas, as cabras e o gado pastarem diante daquele monte."
pt.R: Ninguém pode subir contigo. Ninguém pode ficar em parte alguma do monte. Não deixes nem mesmo as ovelhas ou o gado comerem capim perto do monte."

am.L: ማንም ከአንተ ጋር አይውጣ፤ ደግሞም በተራራው ሁሉ ላይ ማንም አይታይ፤ በጎችና ከብቶችም በዚያ ተራራ ፊት ለፊት አይሰማሩ።»
am.B: ከአንተ ጋር ማንም አይውጣ፤ በተራራውም ላይ በየትም ቦታ ሌላ ሰው አይታይ። የበግና የፍየል መንጋዎችም ሆኑ የከብት መንጋዎች በዚያ ተራራ ፊት ለፊት እንኳ አይሰማሩ።»
am.R: ማንም ከአንተ ጋር መምጣት የለበትም። በተራራው ላይ በየትም ቦታ ማንም መኖር የለበትም። በጎችና ከብቶች እንኳ በተራራው አጠገብ ሣር አይጋጡ።»

decisions.choice: let no one be seen on all the mountain: the mountain is holy ground
decisions.reason: When God came down on Sinai the first time, the people and their animals were kept back by a boundary (19:12-13, 21-24). The same holiness surrounds the mountain now. Not even Joshua, who went partway with Moses before (24:13), may come.

decisions.choice: the flocks and the herds: sheep and goats, and cattle
decisions.reason: The first word covers small livestock, both sheep and goats; the second means cattle. Together they mean all the animals.

source.text: וַיִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי־לֻחֹ֨ת אֲבָנִ֜ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם מֹשֶׁ֤ה בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַיַּ֨עַל֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he cut two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and rose early Moses in the morning and went up to [the] mountain of Sinai just as had commanded Yahweh him, and he took in his hand two tablets of stone.

en.L: And he cut two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and Moses rose early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him, and he took in his hand two tablets of stone.
en.B: So Moses cut two stone tablets like the first ones. Early next morning he went up Mount Sinai, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded him, carrying the two stone tablets in his hand.
en.R: So Moses cut out two stone tablets like the first ones. He got up early the next morning and climbed Mount Sinai, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told him. He carried the two stone tablets with him.

es.L: Y talló dos tablas de piedra como las primeras; y se levantó Moisés temprano por la mañana y subió al monte Sinaí, tal como le había mandado {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y tomó en su mano dos tablas de piedra.
es.B: Así que Moisés labró dos tablas de piedra iguales a las primeras. Temprano a la mañana siguiente subió al monte Sinaí, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había ordenado, llevando en la mano las dos tablas de piedra.
es.R: Así que Moisés cortó dos tablas de piedra como las primeras. Se levantó temprano a la mañana siguiente y subió al monte Sinaí, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho. Llevaba consigo las dos tablas de piedra.

fr.L: Et il tailla deux tables de pierre comme les premières ; et Moïse se leva tôt le matin et monta sur le mont Sinaï, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné, et il prit dans sa main deux tables de pierre.
fr.B: Moïse tailla donc deux tables de pierre pareilles aux premières. Tôt le lendemain matin, il gravit le mont Sinaï, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait ordonné, en portant à la main les deux tables de pierre.
fr.R: Alors Moïse a taillé deux tables de pierre comme les premières. Il s’est levé tôt le lendemain matin et il est monté sur le mont Sinaï, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le lui avait dit. Il a emporté avec lui les deux tables de pierre.

sw.L: Akachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza; Musa akaamka asubuhi na mapema, akapanda mlima Sinai, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru, akachukua mkononi mwake vibao viwili vya mawe.
sw.B: Basi Musa alichonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza. Kesho yake alfajiri akapanda mlima Sinai, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru, akiwa amebeba mkononi vile vibao viwili vya mawe.
sw.R: Basi Musa alichonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza. Akaamka mapema asubuhi iliyofuata, akapanda mlima Sinai, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwambia. Alivibeba vibao vile viwili vya mawe.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 깎아 만들었다. 그리고 모세는 아침 일찍 일어나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그에게 명령하신 대로 시내 산으로 올라갔는데, 돌판 두 개를 자기 손에 들고 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 모세는 처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 깎아 만들었다. 그리고 이튿날 아침 일찍 일어나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 대로 돌판 두 개를 손에 들고 시내 산으로 올라갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 모세는 처음 것과 같은 돌판 두 개를 깎아 만들었다. 그는 다음 날 아침 일찍 일어나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 시내 산으로 올라갔다. 그는 그 돌판 두 개를 손에 들고 갔다.

vi.L: Ông đục hai bảng đá giống như [hai bảng] trước. Môi-se dậy sớm vào buổi sáng và đi lên núi Si-na-i, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho ông, và ông cầm trong tay hai bảng đá.
vi.B: Vậy Môi-se đục hai bảng đá giống như hai bảng trước. Sáng hôm sau, ông dậy sớm và đi lên núi Si-na-i như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho ông, tay cầm hai bảng đá.
vi.R: Vậy Môi-se đục hai bảng đá giống như hai bảng trước. Sáng hôm sau ông dậy sớm và leo lên núi Si-na-i, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã bảo ông. Ông mang theo hai bảng đá.

pt.L: E ele talhou duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e Moisés se levantou cedo pela manhã e subiu ao monte Sinai, conforme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe tinha ordenado, e tomou na sua mão duas tábuas de pedra.
pt.B: Então Moisés talhou duas tábuas de pedra iguais às primeiras. Bem cedo na manhã seguinte, subiu o monte Sinai, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe tinha ordenado, levando na mão as duas tábuas de pedra.
pt.R: Então Moisés cortou duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras. Ele se levantou cedo na manhã seguinte e subiu o monte Sinai, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha mandado. Ele levou consigo as duas tábuas de pedra.

am.L: እርሱም እንደ ፊተኞቹ ያሉ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ጠረበ፤ ሙሴም ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘውም ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጣ፤ ሁለቱንም የድንጋይ ጽላቶች በእጁ ያዘ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ሙሴ እንደ መጀመሪያዎቹ ያሉ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ጠረበ። በማግስቱም ማልዶ ተነሥቶ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳዘዘው ሁለቱን የድንጋይ ጽላቶች በእጁ ይዞ ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጣ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሙሴ እንደ መጀመሪያዎቹ ያሉ ሁለት የድንጋይ ጽላቶችን ጠረበ። በማግስቱ ማልዶ ተነሥቶ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ነገረው ወደ ሲና ተራራ ወጣ። ሁለቱን የድንጋይ ጽላቶችም ይዞ ሄደ።

decisions.choice: just as Yahweh had commanded him: Moses obeys exactly
decisions.reason: The phrase marks careful obedience to God's word (verses 1-2), as it does throughout the making of the tabernacle (39:1-43; 40:16).

decisions.choice: he cut ... Moses: the same person
decisions.reason: The first verb has no named subject; Moses is named in the next clause. He does what God told him in verse 1.

decisions.choice: So Moses cut
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Moses at the first verb and mark the obedience with "So".

source.text: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came down Yahweh in [the] cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed (in) [the] name of Yahweh.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came down in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came down in the cloud and took {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place there beside Moses, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} announced {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came down in a cloud and stood there with Moses. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} announced {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own name, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y descendió {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en la nube, y se puso allí con él, y proclamó el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} descendió en la nube y se colocó allí junto a Moisés, y proclamó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bajó en una nube y se quedó allí con Moisés. Luego anunció {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio nombre: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} descendit dans la nuée, et se tint là avec lui, et proclama le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} descendit dans la nuée et prit place là, auprès de Moïse ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} proclama {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est descendu dans un nuage et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est tenu là avec Moïse. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a annoncé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre nom : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akashuka katika wingu, akasimama pamoja naye huko, akalitangaza jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alishuka katika wingu, akakaa mahali pake pale kando ya Musa, akalitangaza jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alishuka katika wingu, akasimama pale pamoja na Musa. Kisha akatangaza jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 구름 가운데 내려오셔서 거기에서 그와 함께 서시고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 선포하셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 구름 가운데 내려오셔서 거기 모세 곁에 서시고, 자기 이름 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 선포하셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 구름 속에 내려오셔서 모세와 함께 거기에 서셨다. 그리고 자기 이름 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알려 주셨다.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong đám mây, đứng với ông tại đó, và công bố danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong đám mây, đứng bên cạnh Môi-se tại đó, và công bố danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự xuống trong một đám mây và đứng đó với Môi-se. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} công bố danh của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} desceu na nuvem e se pôs ali com ele, e proclamou o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} desceu na nuvem e se colocou ali ao lado de Moisés, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} anunciou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} desceu numa nuvem e ficou ali com Moisés. Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} anunciou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio nome, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም በደመና ወረደ፤ በዚያም ከእርሱ ጋር ቆመ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ስም አወጀ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በደመና ወረደ፤ በዚያም በሙሴ አጠገብ ቆመ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የተባለውንም ስሙን አወጀ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በደመና ወርዶ ከሙሴ ጋር በዚያ ቆመ። ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚለውን የራሱን ስም አወጀ።

decisions.choice: proclaimed the name: Yahweh proclaims his own name
alternatives: Moses called on the name of Yahweh
decisions.reason: The subject of "stood" and "proclaimed" is not named again. In 33:19 God promised Moses, "I will proclaim the name 'Yahweh' before you", and in verse 6 Yahweh proclaims. So it is most likely God who announces his name here. The same words can mean "called on the name of Yahweh", as when Abram worshiped (Genesis 12:8; 13:4); then Moses would be the one calling.

decisions.choice: came down in the cloud: God's presence at Sinai
decisions.reason: God came down on Sinai in a thick cloud (19:9, 18-20) and spoke with Moses from the cloud at the tent of meeting (33:9-11). What God promised in 33:19-23 now happens.

decisions.choice: beside Moses / with Moses; his name
decisions.reason: "Him" is Moses, so Balanced and Readable name him. Because God himself proclaims the name (see the note), they say "his name".

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה׀עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה׀יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׀

records.literal_gloss: And passed by Yahweh before his face and proclaimed, Yahweh, Yahweh, God compassionate and gracious, long of anger(s) and great of steadfast love and faithfulness,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} passed by before his face and proclaimed, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a God compassionate and gracious, long of anger, and great in steadfast love and faithfulness,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} passed in front of Moses and called out, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a God of tender compassion and grace, slow to grow angry, rich in faithful love and in truth,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} passed in front of Moses and called out, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}! He is a God of tender mercy and kindness. He is slow to become angry. His faithful love is great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} can always be trusted.

es.L: Y pasó {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} delante de su rostro y proclamó: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, un Dios compasivo y benévolo, lento para la ira, y grande en amor leal y en verdad,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pasó frente a Moisés y proclamó en voz alta: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, un Dios de compasión entrañable y de gracia, lento para enojarse, rico en amor fiel y en verdad,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pasó frente a Moisés anunciando en voz alta: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Es un Dios lleno de ternura y de bondad. No se enoja fácilmente. Su amor fiel es grande, y siempre se puede confiar en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} passa devant sa face et proclama : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, un Dieu compatissant et favorable, lent à la colère, et grand en amour fidèle et en vérité,

decisions.choice: proclaimed, "Yahweh, Yahweh": the name, spoken twice, begins the proclamation
alternatives: and Yahweh proclaimed: "Yahweh is a God compassionate ..."
decisions.reason: God passes by Moses, as promised in 33:22, and proclaims. The name may be called out twice for weight, or the first "Yahweh" may be the one who proclaims and the second the start of what is proclaimed ("Yahweh proclaimed: Yahweh is a God ..."). Either way, the words that follow describe who Yahweh is, the answer to Moses' prayer "show me your glory" (33:18-19).

decisions.choice: compassionate: tender, warm love that pities
decisions.reason: The word is related to the word for womb and describes the deep, protective love of a parent for a child (Psalm 103:13; Isaiah 49:15). In the Old Testament this adjective is used almost only of God.

decisions.choice: gracious: showing undeserved favor
decisions.reason: The word describes one who gives kindness that is not earned. Its root is the word for the "favor" Moses has found in God's eyes (33:12-17; 34:9).

decisions.choice: long of anger: slow to become angry, patient
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures anger as a nose or nostrils that are "long", slow to burn hot. It means patient and slow to punish (Proverbs 14:29; 16:32).

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal, faithful love that keeps covenant
decisions.reason: The word means kindness and love that are loyal to a relationship and do not give up. It is the love God promised in 20:6 and showed in leading his people out of Egypt (15:13). "Great in" it means God has it in abundance.

decisions.choice: faithfulness: reliability, truth
decisions.reason: The word means firmness and reliability: being true, keeping one's word. Paired with steadfast love, it says that God's love can be depended on (Genesis 24:27; Psalm 25:10).

decisions.choice: the confession repeated through Scripture
decisions.reason: These words become Israel's confession of who God is. Moses quotes them when he pleads for the people (Numbers 14:18). They are echoed in Psalm 86:15, 103:8 and 145:8, Nehemiah 9:17, Joel 2:13 and Jonah 4:2. Joel and Jonah add that God "relents from disaster"; Jonah complains that God is like this toward Nineveh.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "faithful love", as in 15:13 and 20:6; Literal says "steadfast love". Both carry the loyalty in the word, which "love" alone would lose.

decisions.choice: truth (Balanced); can always be trusted (Readable)
decisions.reason: With "faithful love" just before it, "faithfulness" would repeat the same idea in the same word. Balanced says "truth", in the sense of being true; Readable says what it means for God: he can be trusted. Literal keeps "faithfulness".

decisions.choice: long of anger
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced says "slow to grow angry" and Readable "slow to become angry".

decisions.choice: He is ... He is ... His faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable turns the list of titles into short sentences about Yahweh, keeping the third person of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: compasivo y benévolo (L); de compasión entrañable y de gracia (B); lleno de ternura y de bondad (R)
decisions.reason: The first word is related to the word for womb (m2); Balanced says "compasión entrañable", whose "entrañas" carries the same picture, and Readable says "ternura". The second describes undeserved favor (m3): "benévolo" (L), "gracia" (B), "bondad" (R). This is the wording for this confession wherever it is quoted again (Numbers 14:18 and later).

decisions.choice: lento para la ira (L); lento para enojarse (B); no se enoja fácilmente (R); verdad for the last word (L, B)
decisions.reason: Word for word, "largo de ira" would read as anger that lasts long, the opposite of the sense (m4), so Literal uses the short fixed phrase. The last word (m6) is "verdad" at Literal and Balanced, because "fidelidad" right after "amor fiel" would repeat the same word; Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: compatissant et favorable (L); plein de tendre compassion et de grâce (B); plein de tendresse et de bonté (R)
decisions.reason: The first word is related to the word for womb (m2), so Balanced and Readable say "tendresse", "tendre compassion". The second is undeserved favor (m3): Literal says "favorable", keeping its link with the "faveur" Moses found (verse 9; 33:12-17). This is the wording for this confession wherever it is quoted again (Numbers 14:18 and later).

decisions.choice: lent à la colère (L); lent à se mettre en colère (B); ne se met pas vite en colère (R); vérité for the last word (L, B)
decisions.reason: Word for word, "long de colère" would read as anger that lasts long, the opposite of the sense (m4), so Literal uses the short fixed phrase. The last word (m6) is "vérité" at Literal and Balanced, because "fidélité" right after "amour fidèle" would repeat the same word; Readable says what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Mungu wa huruma na wa neema (L); mwenye huruma ya moyoni (B); mkawivu wa hasira (L), anayechelewa kukasirika (B), hakasiriki upesi (R)
decisions.reason: "Huruma" is the warm, pitying love of the first word (m2); Balanced adds "ya moyoni" for its inward depth; "neema" is undeserved favor (m3). "Long of anger" cannot be copied: a "long anger" would mean anger that lasts, the opposite of the sense (m4), so every level says slow to become angry. This is the wording for this confession wherever it is quoted again (Numbers 14:18 and later).

decisions.choice: mwingi wa upendo usiokoma na uaminifu (L); aliyejaa upendo usiokoma na kweli (B); upendo wake usiokoma (R)
decisions.reason: "Upendo usiokoma" (love that does not stop) carries the loyalty of the word (m5) at every level of this confession, as in Numbers 14:18; "rehema" (mercy) would lose it. The last word (m6) is "uaminifu" at Literal and "kweli" (true, reliable) at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B); "변함없는 사랑" (R) for *ḥesed*; "신실함" for faithfulness
decisions.reason: As the Genesis and Psalms term sheets: *ḥesed* is the loyal love that keeps covenant (meaning decision m5). "신실함" says the reliability the second word means (m6); "진실" would narrow it to telling the truth.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (Literal, Balanced), "tình thương thành tín" (Readable) for *ḥesed*; "chân thật" / "đáng tin cậy" for *ʾemet*
decisions.reason: The Psalms and Genesis words for *ḥesed*, so this confession reads the same where the Psalms repeat it (86:15; 103:8; 145:8).

decisions.choice: "chậm giận" (Literal); "chậm nóng giận" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has a short idiom close to the Hebrew "long of anger"; Literal keeps it as the Vietnamese Psalms do.

decisions.choice: compassivo e misericordioso, longo de ira (L) / lento para se irar (B), grande em (L) / cheio de (B) amor leal e fidelidade; R: compaixão, bondade, demora a ficar irado, amor leal, confiar
decisions.reason: This confession is quoted through the Old Testament (m7), so its words are set here for Exodus and for the passages that echo it. "Compassivo" renders the tender love of m2 and shares its root with "compaixão" in 33:19; "misericordioso" is the one who shows kindness that is not earned (m3). Literal keeps "longo de ira", as the English Literal keeps "long of anger" (r-en-3); Balanced says "lento para se irar" (m4). Hesed is "amor leal" at every level here, as the terms list allows ("o amor leal, a lealdade, a bondade fiel"): "lealdade" beside "fidelidade" at Literal would name nearly the same thing twice. Balanced keeps "fidelidade" where the English Balanced says "truth" (r-en-2), because in Portuguese "amor leal e fidelidade" does not repeat a word; Readable says what it means, "sempre se pode confiar nele". The older Portuguese wording ("clemente", "longânimo", "grande em misericórdia") is not followed.

decisions.choice: Ele é um Deus ...; o seu amor leal ... nele
decisions.reason: Readable turns the list into short sentences in the third person, as the English Readable does (r-en-4); God speaks of himself as "Ele", so "seu" and "nele" take the deity_pronoun span, while the sentence-initial "Ele" is written plainly.

decisions.choice: "ርኅሩኅ" for compassionate; "ቸር" (L, R) and "ጸጋ የሞላው" (B) for gracious; "አምላክ" for El
decisions.reason: "ርኅሩኅ" (from "ርኅራኄ") is tender, pitying love, the sense of m2, and the same root as the verb in 33:19 ("ርኅራኄ ለማሳየው"). "ቸር" is one who gives kindness freely, the root used for the verb "be gracious" in 33:19, so the two verses echo as the Hebrew does; Balanced, following its English "grace", says "ጸጋ". El, "God" as a predicate, is "አምላክ", as the style guide has for "a God". The proclamation is echoed through the Old Testament (Numbers 14:18; Nehemiah 9:17; Psalm 86:15; 103:8; Joel 2:13; Jonah 4:2), so these words should be kept wherever it returns.

decisions.choice: "ለቁጣ የዘገየ" (L), "ቶሎ የማይቆጣ" (B, R); "ጽኑ ፍቅር" for steadfast love; "ታማኝነት" (L), "እውነት" (B), "የሚታመን" (R) for faithfulness
decisions.reason: A word-for-word "ቁጣው የረዘመ" would read as anger that lasts long, the opposite of the Hebrew, so even Literal uses the Amharic idiom "ለቁጣ የዘገየ" (slow to anger). Steadfast love is "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level, as the Pentateuch terms have it, and faithfulness follows each English level: "faithfulness" (L), "truth" (B), "can always be trusted" (R).

source.text: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֨סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד׀עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל־בָּנִים֙ וְעַל־בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: keeping steadfast love to thousands, lifting iniquity and transgression and sin, and leaving unpunished not he leaves unpunished, visiting [the] iniquity of fathers on sons and on sons of sons, on third-generation and on fourth-generation.

en.L: keeping steadfast love to thousands, bearing iniquity and transgression and sin, but he will by no means acquit [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of fathers on {{gender:children|sons}} and on {{gender:children's children|sons' sons}}, on the third and on the fourth [generation]."
en.B: who keeps faithful love for thousands and forgives wrongdoing, rebellion and sin. Yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will never acquit the guilty; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings the wrongdoing of {{gender:parents|fathers}} upon their {{gender:children and grandchildren|sons and grandsons}}, to the third and the fourth generation."
en.R: He keeps showing faithful love to thousands. He forgives evil, rebellion and sin. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not let the guilty go free. He deals with the sin of {{gender:parents|fathers}} in the lives of their {{gender:children and grandchildren|sons and grandsons}}, even as far as the third and fourth generation."

es.L: que guarda amor leal para millares, que carga con la iniquidad, la rebelión y el pecado, pero que de ningún modo absuelve [al culpable], que visita la iniquidad de los padres sobre los hijos y sobre los hijos de los hijos, sobre la tercera y sobre la cuarta [generación].»
es.B: que mantiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel a millares y perdona la maldad, la rebelión y el pecado. Pero nunca declara inocente al culpable; hace recaer la maldad de los padres sobre sus hijos y sus nietos, hasta la tercera y la cuarta generación.»
es.R: Sigue mostrando {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel a miles. Perdona el mal, la rebelión y el pecado. Pero no deja que el culpable quede libre. Pide cuentas del pecado de los padres en la vida de sus hijos y nietos, hasta la tercera y la cuarta generación.»

fr.L: qui garde l’amour fidèle pour des milliers, qui lève la faute, la transgression et le péché, mais qui ne tient nullement [le coupable] pour innocent, qui visite la faute des pères sur les {{gender:enfants|fils}} et sur les {{gender:enfants des enfants|fils des fils}}, sur la troisième et sur la quatrième [génération]. »
fr.B: qui maintient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle pour des milliers et pardonne la faute, la rébellion et le péché. Pourtant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne déclare jamais innocent le coupable ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait retomber la faute des {{gender:parents|pères}} sur leurs {{gender:enfants et petits-enfants|fils et petits-fils}}, jusqu’à la troisième et la quatrième génération. »
fr.R: Il continue de montrer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle à des milliers. Il pardonne le mal, la révolte et le péché. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laisse pas le coupable impuni. Il demande compte du péché des {{gender:parents|pères}} jusque dans la vie de leurs {{gender:enfants et petits-enfants|fils et petits-fils}}, et même jusqu’à la troisième et la quatrième génération. »

sw.L: akilinda upendo usiokoma kwa maelfu, akiuchukua uovu na uasi na dhambi, lakini hamhesabu kamwe [mwenye hatia] kuwa hana hatia, akiuleta uovu wa baba juu ya watoto na juu ya watoto wa watoto, juu ya [kizazi cha] tatu na juu ya [kizazi cha] nne."
sw.B: anayedumisha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa maelfu, na kusamehe uovu, uasi na dhambi. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hamtangazi kamwe mwenye hatia kuwa hana hatia; huuleta uovu wa wazazi juu ya watoto wao na wajukuu wao, hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne."
sw.R: Anaendelea kuwaonyesha maelfu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma. Anasamehe uovu, uasi na dhambi. Lakini hamwachi mwenye hatia aende huru. Hushughulikia dhambi ya wazazi hata katika maisha ya watoto wao na wajukuu wao, mpaka kizazi cha tatu na cha nne."

ko.L: 수천 [대]에게 한결같은 사랑을 지키고, 죄악과 허물과 죄를 용서하지만, 결코 [죄 있는 자를] 죄 없다 하지 않고, 아버지들의 죄악을 {{gender:자녀|아들들}}과 {{gender:자녀의 자녀|아들의 아들들}}에게, 삼 대와 사 대에까지 갚는다."
ko.B: 수천 대에 이르기까지 한결같은 사랑을 베풀고, 죄악과 허물과 죄를 용서한다. 그러나 죄 있는 사람을 결코 죄 없다 하지 않고, {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄악을 {{gender:자녀와 손자녀|아들과 손자}}에게 삼 대와 사 대까지 갚는다."
ko.R: 그는 수천 대까지 변함없는 사랑을 베푼다. 악한 일과 반역과 죄를 용서한다. 그러나 죄지은 사람을 그냥 내버려 두지는 않는다. {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 죄를 {{gender:자녀와 손자녀|아들과 손자}}의 삶에서 다루어, 삼 대와 사 대까지 이르게 한다."

vi.L: giữ tình yêu thương thành tín đến hàng ngàn [đời], tha thứ gian ác, sự phạm luật và tội lỗi; nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chẳng hề coi [kẻ có tội] là vô tội, thăm phạt gian ác của cha trên con cái và trên con cái của con cái, đến [đời] thứ ba và [đời] thứ tư."
vi.B: Ngài giữ tình yêu thương thành tín đến hàng ngàn đời, tha thứ gian ác, sự phạm luật và tội lỗi. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ coi kẻ có tội là vô tội. Ngài bắt tội lỗi của {{gender:cha mẹ|cha ông}} đổ trên con cháu, cho đến đời thứ ba và đời thứ tư."
vi.R: Ngài luôn tỏ tình thương thành tín cho hàng ngàn người. Ngài tha thứ điều ác, sự phản nghịch và tội lỗi. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để kẻ có tội được thoát. Hậu quả tội lỗi của {{gender:cha mẹ|cha ông}} sẽ đổ trên đời sống con cháu, cho đến đời thứ ba và đời thứ tư."

pt.L: que guarda amor leal para milhares, que carrega a iniquidade, a rebeldia e o pecado, mas de modo nenhum inocenta [o culpado], que visita a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos e sobre os filhos dos filhos, sobre a terceira e sobre a quarta [geração]."
pt.B: que mantém o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal por milhares e perdoa a maldade, a rebeldia e o pecado. Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} jamais deixa impune o culpado; faz cair a culpa dos pais sobre os filhos e os netos, até a terceira e a quarta geração."
pt.R: Ele continua a mostrar amor leal a milhares. Ele perdoa o mal, a rebeldia e o pecado. Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não deixa o culpado ficar sem castigo. Ele trata do pecado dos pais na vida dos filhos e dos netos, até a terceira e a quarta geração."

am.L: ለሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅርን የሚጠብቅ፣ በደልንና መተላለፍን ኃጢአትንም የሚሸከም፣ [በደለኛውን] ግን ከቶ ንጹሕ የማያደርግ፣ የአባቶችን በደል በልጆችና በልጅ ልጆች ላይ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ [ትውልድ] የሚያመጣ።»
am.B: ለሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅርን የሚጠብቅ፣ በደልን፣ ዓመፅንና ኃጢአትን ይቅር የሚል ነው። በደለኛውን ግን ከቶ ንጹሕ ነው አይልም፤ {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} በደል እስከ ሦስተኛና አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ በልጆቻቸውና በልጅ ልጆቻቸው ላይ ያመጣል።»
am.R: ለሺዎች ጽኑ ፍቅሩን ማሳየቱን ይቀጥላል። ክፋትን፣ ዓመፅንና ኃጢአትን ይቅር ይላል። በደለኛውን ግን ሳይቀጣ አይተውም። {{gender:የወላጆችን|የአባቶችን}} ኃጢአት በልጆቻቸውና በልጅ ልጆቻቸው ሕይወት ላይ እስከ ሦስተኛና አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ ያስከትላል።»

decisions.choice: keeping steadfast love to thousands: love that lasts far beyond punishment
decisions.reason: "Keeping" means guarding and maintaining. "Thousands" stands against "the third and the fourth generation" at the end of the verse, so it may mean thousands of generations, as Deuteronomy 7:9 says ("to a thousand generations"; compare 20:6). It may also mean thousands of people. Either way God's love far outweighs his judgment.

decisions.choice: bearing iniquity and transgression and sin: forgiving sin of every kind
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift up and carry; with sin as its object it means to carry it away, to forgive (Psalm 32:1, 5). The three nouns are the main words for wrongdoing: iniquity (twisted, crooked wrong and the guilt it brings), transgression (rebellion, breaking faith) and sin (missing the mark). Together they mean every kind of wrong.

decisions.choice: he will by no means acquit: he will certainly not treat the guilty as innocent
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis: "acquitting, he will not acquit". Its object, the guilty, is understood. Forgiveness does not mean that God pretends wrong was never done (Numbers 14:18; Nahum 1:3).

decisions.choice: visiting the iniquity of fathers on children: the effects of sin reach later generations
decisions.reason: To "visit" is to attend to, here to bring the consequences of wrongdoing. The third and fourth generations are the great-grandchildren and their children, the most that might live in one household together. In 20:5 the same words add "of those who hate me". Other passages make clear that each person answers for his own sin (Deuteronomy 24:16; Ezekiel 18:20).

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in verse 6; Literal says "steadfast love".

decisions.choice: will never acquit the guilty (Balanced); will not let the guilty go free (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name "the guilty" without brackets and render the doubled verb with "never" or a plain "not".

decisions.choice: deals with the sin of parents in the lives of
decisions.reason: Readable says what "visiting iniquity on" means in plain words: God's dealing with sin reaches the descendants. Literal keeps "visiting".

decisions.choice: carga con la iniquidad
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift and carry away (m2); Literal keeps the picture with "carga con", and Balanced and Readable say what it means, "perdona".

decisions.choice: los padres ... los hijos (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" and "hijos" already include mothers and daughters, so the English gender spans have no Spanish counterpart here.

decisions.choice: qui lève la faute
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift up and carry away (m2). Literal says "lève", as it says "lever le nom" for the same verb in 20:7; "porter la faute" would suggest bearing the punishment. Balanced and Readable say "pardonne".

decisions.choice: ne tient nullement [le coupable] pour innocent (L); ne déclare jamais innocent le coupable (B); ne laisse pas le coupable impuni (R)
decisions.reason: The doubled verb (m3) is carried by "nullement" and "jamais"; "tenir pour innocent" is the wording used for the same verb in 20:7. The same forms are used where Numbers 14:18 quotes this verse.

decisions.choice: akiuchukua uovu
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of lifting and carrying sin away (m2), as Numbers 14:18 does; Balanced and Readable say "kusamehe".

decisions.choice: hamhesabu kamwe [mwenye hatia] kuwa hana hatia (L); hamtangazi kamwe mwenye hatia kuwa hana hatia (B)
decisions.reason: The doubled verb (m3) means God will never treat or declare the guilty innocent; "kamwe" carries the emphasis. Readable says "hamwachi mwenye hatia aende huru".

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들들}}, {{gender:부모|아버지}} and the like, as the English spans
decisions.reason: Korean has two current ways of saying "sons" here, the inclusive "자녀" and the traditional "아들", so the Korean takes the gender spans where the English has them.

decisions.choice: "죄악과 허물과 죄" (L, B); "악한 일과 반역과 죄" (R); "용서하다" for "bearing"
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch term sheet: iniquity "죄악", transgression "허물", sin "죄". The verb "lift, bear" means forgiving here (meaning decision m2); Korean "짊어지다" would suggest God carries the punishment, so every level says "용서하다".

decisions.choice: "đến hàng ngàn [đời]" (Literal)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese needs a noun after "hàng ngàn"; "đời" (generations) follows the end of the verse, as the meaning decision explains. Balanced keeps it without brackets; Readable follows the English "thousands".

decisions.choice: {{gender:cha mẹ|cha ông}}; "con cháu" with no span
decisions.reason: As the English: "cha mẹ" (parents) by default, "cha ông" (fathers) as the alternative. "con cháu" already includes sons and daughters, so it needs no span; Literal keeps "cha" and "con cái".

decisions.choice: os filhos, os filhos dos filhos (L); os filhos e os netos (B, R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "children" and "sons"; Portuguese "filhos" and "netos" already include daughters and granddaughters (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: carrega (L), perdoa (B, R); a iniquidade (L), a maldade (B), o mal (R); visita (L), faz cair a culpa (B), trata do pecado (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of lifting and carrying sin away (m2) with "carregar", as the English Literal says "bearing"; Balanced and Readable say "perdoar". The three words for wrongdoing follow the terms list ("iniquidade" at Literal, "maldade", "rebeldia", "pecado"). Balanced says "faz cair a culpa dos pais sobre", the wording of 20:5, and Readable follows the English Readable (r-en-3).

decisions.choice: no gender span on "ልጆች" and "የልጅ ልጆች"; a gender span offering "ወላጆች" or "አባቶች" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" and "የልጅ ልጆች" already include daughters and granddaughters, so Amharic has no second wording for the English span on "children"; "parents" and "fathers", which the English Balanced and Readable offer, are two real Amharic wordings ("ወላጆች", "አባቶች") and keep the span. Literal keeps "አባቶች", as its English does. The same holds for "የእስራኤል ልጆች" through this chapter.

source.text: וַיְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And hurried Moses and bowed low [to the] ground and bowed down.

en.L: And Moses hurried and bowed his head to the ground and bowed down.
en.B: Moses quickly sank down with his face to the ground in worship.
en.R: Right away Moses bowed down low to the ground and worshiped God.

es.L: Y Moisés se apresuró, e inclinó la cabeza a tierra, y se postró.
es.B: Moisés se apresuró a postrarse rostro en tierra en adoración.
es.R: En seguida Moisés se inclinó hasta el suelo y adoró a Dios.

fr.L: Et Moïse se hâta, et il inclina la tête jusqu’à terre, et se prosterna.
fr.B: Moïse se jeta aussitôt face contre terre pour adorer.
fr.R: Tout de suite, Moïse s’est incliné très bas jusqu’au sol et il a adoré Dieu.

sw.L: Musa akafanya haraka, akainamisha kichwa chake hadi chini, akasujudu.
sw.B: Mara moja Musa aliinama uso hadi chini, akaabudu.
sw.R: Mara moja Musa aliinama chini kabisa, akamwabudu Mungu.

ko.L: 그러자 모세가 서둘러 머리를 땅에 숙이고 엎드려 경배했다.
ko.B: 모세는 곧바로 땅에 엎드려 경배했다.
ko.R: 모세는 바로 땅에 엎드려 하나님께 경배했다.

vi.L: Môi-se vội vàng cúi đầu xuống đất và thờ lạy.
vi.B: Môi-se lập tức sấp mặt xuống đất mà thờ lạy.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức Môi-se cúi rạp xuống đất và thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: E Moisés se apressou, e inclinou a cabeça até o chão, e se prostrou.
pt.B: Moisés logo se curvou com o rosto em terra, em adoração.
pt.R: Imediatamente Moisés se curvou até o chão e adorou a Deus.

am.L: ሙሴም ቸኮለ፤ ወደ ምድርም አጎንብሶ ሰገደ።
am.B: ሙሴም ፈጥኖ በግንባሩ ወደ ምድር ተደፍቶ ሰገደ።
am.R: ሙሴ ወዲያውኑ እስከ መሬት ዝቅ ብሎ እግዚአብሔርን አመለከ።

decisions.choice: bowed low ... bowed down: knelt with his face to the ground and worshiped
decisions.reason: The first verb means to bow the head low; the second to bow down to the ground, the posture of worship (4:31; 12:27). Together they describe full reverence before God.

decisions.choice: hurried: at once
decisions.reason: "Hurried" goes with the following verbs: Moses bowed down without delay.

decisions.choice: worshiped God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one Moses worshiped.

source.text: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר אִם־נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י יֵֽלֶךְ־נָ֥א אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּקִרְבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֨רֶף֙ ה֔וּא וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, if please I have found favor in your eyes, my Lord, let go please my Lord in our midst, for a people stiff of neck [is] it, and you will forgive our iniquity and our sin and you will take us as a possession.

en.L: And he said, "If, please, I have found favor in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, my Lord, let my Lord, please, go in our midst, for it [is] a stiff-necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance."
en.B: He said, "Lord, if I really have found favor with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, then please, Lord, go in our midst. These are a stubborn people. Forgive our wrongdoing and our sin, and claim us as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own possession."
en.R: Moses said, "Lord, if {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are pleased with me, please go along with us. These people are stubborn. But forgive our evil and our sin, and make us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} very own people."

es.L: Y dijo: «Si, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego, he hallado favor ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, Señor mío, camine, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ruego, mi Señor en medio de nosotros, porque es un pueblo de cuello rígido; y perdona nuestra iniquidad y nuestro pecado, y haz de nosotros {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} herencia.»
es.B: Dijo: «Señor, si de verdad cuento con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} favor, entonces, Señor, camina en medio de nosotros. Este es un pueblo terco. Perdona nuestra maldad y nuestro pecado, y reclámanos como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propia posesión.»
es.R: Moisés dijo: «Señor, si {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agrado, por favor ven con nosotros. Este pueblo es terco. Pero perdona nuestra maldad y nuestro pecado, y haz que seamos un pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenezca solo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.»

fr.L: Et il dit : « Si, de grâce, j’ai trouvé faveur à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, mon Seigneur, que mon Seigneur marche, de grâce, au milieu de nous, car c’est un peuple au cou raide ; et pardonne notre faute et notre péché, et prends-nous pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage. »
fr.B: Il dit : « Seigneur, si j’ai vraiment trouvé faveur auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, alors, Seigneur, viens donc au milieu de nous. Ce peuple est têtu. Pardonne nos fautes et notre péché, et fais de nous {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} possession. »
fr.R: Moïse a dit : « Seigneur, si je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plais, viens donc avec nous. Ce peuple est têtu. Mais pardonne notre mal et notre péché, et fais de nous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »

sw.L: Akasema, "Tafadhali, ikiwa nimepata kibali machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, Bwana wangu, Bwana wangu na atembee, tafadhali, katikati yetu, kwa maana ni watu wenye shingo ngumu; {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} usamehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, na kutuchukua tuwe urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}."
sw.B: Akasema, "Bwana, ikiwa kweli nimepata kibali {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, basi, Bwana, tafadhali uende katikati yetu. Watu hawa ni wakaidi. Usamehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, na utufanye tuwe mali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}."
sw.R: Musa akasema, "Bwana, ikiwa unapendezwa nami, tafadhali uende pamoja nasi. Watu hawa ni wakaidi. Lakini utusamehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, na utufanye tuwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kabisa."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "주님, 제가 주님의 눈에 은혜를 입었다면, 제발 주님께서 저희 가운데서 함께 가 주십시오. 이들은 목이 뻣뻣한 백성입니다. 저희의 죄악과 죄를 용서하시고, 저희를 주님의 소유로 삼아 주십시오."
ko.B: 모세가 말했다. "주님, 제가 참으로 주님께 은혜를 입었다면, 주님, 부디 저희 가운데서 함께 가 주십시오. 이 백성은 고집이 셉니다. 저희의 죄악과 죄를 용서하시고, 저희를 주님의 소유로 삼아 주십시오."
ko.R: 모세가 말했다. "주님, 주님께서 저를 좋게 보신다면, 제발 저희와 함께 가 주십시오. 이 백성은 고집이 셉니다. 그래도 저희의 악한 일과 죄를 용서해 주시고, 저희를 주님의 백성으로 삼아 주십시오."

vi.L: Ông thưa: "Lạy Chúa, nếu con thật đã được ơn trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin Chúa đi giữa chúng con, vì đó [là] một dân cứng cổ; xin tha thứ gian ác và tội lỗi chúng con, và nhận chúng con làm cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Ông thưa: "Lạy Chúa, nếu con thật được ơn trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin Chúa đi giữa chúng con. Dân này thật cứng cổ, nhưng xin tha thứ gian ác và tội lỗi chúng con, và nhận chúng con làm cơ nghiệp riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Môi-se thưa: "Lạy Chúa, nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đẹp lòng về con, xin hãy đi cùng chúng con. Dân này bướng bỉnh. Nhưng xin tha thứ điều ác và tội lỗi của chúng con, và nhận chúng con làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

pt.L: E disse: "Se, por favor, achei favor aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, meu Senhor, que o meu Senhor, por favor, vá no meio de nós, pois [é] um povo de dura cerviz; e perdoa a nossa iniquidade e o nosso pecado, e toma-nos por {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} herança."
pt.B: Ele disse: "Senhor, se de fato encontrei favor diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, então, por favor, Senhor, vai no meio de nós. Este é um povo teimoso. Perdoa a nossa maldade e o nosso pecado, e toma-nos como {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} propriedade."
pt.R: Moisés disse: "Senhor, se estás contente comigo, por favor, vai conosco. Este povo é teimoso. Mas perdoa a nossa maldade e o nosso pecado, e faz de nós o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio povo."

am.L: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ጌታዬ ሆይ፣ በዓይንህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፣ እባክህ፣ ጌታዬ በመካከላችን ይሂድ፤ አንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ ነውና፤ በደላችንንና ኃጢአታችንን ይቅር በል፤ ርስትህም አድርገህ ውሰደን።»
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ጌታ ሆይ፣ በእውነት በፊትህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ ከሆነ እባክህ፣ ጌታ ሆይ፣ በመካከላችን ሂድ። ይህ ሕዝብ አንገተ ደንዳና ነው፤ በደላችንንና ኃጢአታችንን ይቅር በል፤ የራስህ ርስት አድርገህም ውሰደን።»
am.R: ሙሴም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ጌታ ሆይ፣ በእኔ ደስ የምትሰኝ ከሆነ እባክህ ከእኛ ጋር ሂድ። እነዚህ ሰዎች እልከኞች ናቸው። ነገር ግን ክፋታችንንና ኃጢአታችንን ይቅር በለን፤ የራስህ ሕዝብም አድርገን።»

decisions.choice: if I have found favor in your eyes, my Lord: a respectful request
decisions.reason: The phrase is a polite way of asking a superior for something. God has already said that Moses has found favor in his eyes (33:12, 17). "My Lord" here is the title, not the divine name.

decisions.choice: for it is a stiff-necked people: the reason God must go with them
alternatives: although it is a stiff-necked people
decisions.reason: The small word can mean "for" or "although". God had said he would not go among them because they were stiff-necked, lest he destroy them (33:3, 5). Moses turns this around: because they are so stubborn, they need God among them, and his forgiveness. Read as "although", Moses admits their stubbornness and asks God to come anyway.

decisions.choice: take us as your inheritance: make us your own possession
decisions.reason: The verb means to take as an inheritance, a family's own land that is never sold. Moses asks God to claim Israel as his own for good (19:5; Deuteronomy 32:9).

decisions.choice: stubborn
decisions.reason: A stiff-necked animal will not turn when it is led (32:9; 33:3). Balanced and Readable say "stubborn"; Literal keeps "stiff-necked". Both leave open whether the clause gives a reason or a concession.

decisions.choice: if you are pleased with me
decisions.reason: Readable says what having found favor in God's eyes means.

decisions.choice: trouvé faveur
decisions.reason: "Faveur" keeps the link with "favorable" in verse 6 (m3 there): the God who shows favor is asked by the one who has found it.

decisions.choice: nimepata kibali
decisions.reason: "Kibali" is favor and acceptance before a superior, the sense of this polite request (m1); "neema" is kept for God's grace in verse 6.

decisions.choice: "주님" for *Adonai*
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide: where the Hebrew has *Adonai* ("my Lord") it is "주님", which keeps it apart from the divine name span.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for *Adonai* ("my Lord")
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese style guide sets: *Adonai* is "Chúa", never written in capitals, kept apart from the divine name.

decisions.choice: meu Senhor (L); Senhor (B, R), not in capitals
decisions.reason: The title here is Adonai, "my Lord" (m1), not the divine name, so it is written "Senhor" with a capital S only, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets it, and is not under the divine name setting. Literal keeps the courtly third person "que o meu Senhor vá", as the Hebrew does; the verbs around it are "tu", Moses' address to God.

decisions.choice: "ጌታዬ ሆይ ... ጌታዬ በመካከላችን ይሂድ" (L); "ጌታ ሆይ ... በመካከላችን ሂድ" (B); "ጌታ ሆይ" (R)
decisions.reason: Adonai ("my Lord") is "ጌታዬ" at Literal, which keeps the Hebrew's respectful third person ("let my Lord go"); Balanced and Readable turn it into the direct address "ጌታ ሆይ" with "አንተ", as people speak to God throughout.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל־עַמְּךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־נִבְרְא֥וּ בְכָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבְכָל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאָ֣ה כָל־הָ֠עָם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֨ה בְקִרְבּ֜וֹ אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־נוֹרָ֣א ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, here! I [am] about to make a covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders which not they have been created in all the earth and among all the nations, and will see all the people which you [are] in its midst the work of Yahweh, that awesome [is] it, which I [am] about to do with you.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Look, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will do wonders that have not been created in all the earth or in any of the nations, and all the people in whose midst you [are] shall see the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for it [is] awesome, what I am doing with you.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Here and now I am making a covenant. In front of all your people I will work marvels such as have never been brought into being anywhere on earth or in any nation. All the people among whom you live will see what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does, for what I am about to do with you will fill them with awe.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Listen! I am making a covenant with you. I will do amazing things in front of all your people. Nothing like them has ever been done anywhere in the world, in any nation. All the people around you will see what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} can do. What I am going to do with you will fill people with awe.

es.L: Y dijo: «Mira, voy a hacer un pacto. Delante de todo tu pueblo haré maravillas que nunca han sido creadas en toda la tierra ni entre todas las naciones, y todo el pueblo en medio del cual [estás] tú verá la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque es imponente lo que yo voy a hacer contigo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Aquí y ahora hago un pacto. Delante de todo tu pueblo realizaré prodigios como nunca se han creado en ningún lugar de la tierra ni en ninguna nación. Todo el pueblo entre el que vives verá lo que hace {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque lo que voy a hacer contigo los llenará de asombro y temor.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «¡Escucha! Hago un pacto contigo. Haré cosas asombrosas delante de todo tu pueblo. Nunca se ha hecho nada igual en ningún lugar del mundo, en ninguna nación. Toda la gente a tu alrededor verá lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} puede hacer. Lo que voy a hacer contigo llenará de temor a la gente.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Voici, je conclus une alliance. Devant tout ton peuple je ferai des merveilles qui n’ont pas été créées sur toute la terre ni dans aucune des nations, et tout le peuple au milieu duquel tu [es] verra l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car elle [est] redoutable, ce que je vais faire avec toi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Ici et maintenant, je conclus une alliance. Devant tout ton peuple, j’accomplirai des prodiges tels qu’il n’en a jamais été créé nulle part sur la terre, ni chez aucune nation. Tout le peuple parmi lequel tu vis verra ce que fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car ce que je vais faire avec toi le remplira de crainte.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : « Écoute ! Je fais une alliance avec toi. Je vais faire des choses extraordinaires devant tout ton peuple. Rien de pareil n’a jamais été fait nulle part dans le monde, chez aucune nation. Tous les gens autour de toi verront ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} peut faire. Ce que je vais faire avec toi remplira les gens de crainte.

sw.L: Akasema, "Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninafanya agano. Mbele ya watu wako wote nitafanya maajabu ambayo hayajaumbwa katika dunia yote wala katika mataifa yoyote, na watu wote ambao wewe [u] katikati yao wataiona kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ni ya kutisha, lile ninalofanya pamoja nawe.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, "Sasa hivi ninafanya agano. Mbele ya watu wako wote nitafanya maajabu ambayo hayajawahi kuumbwa mahali popote duniani wala katika taifa lolote. Watu wote unaoishi kati yao wataona kile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachofanya, kwa maana ninachokwenda kufanya pamoja nawe kitawajaza hofu kuu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, "Sikiliza! Ninafanya agano nawe. Nitafanya mambo ya ajabu mbele ya watu wako wote. Mambo kama hayo hayajawahi kufanyika mahali popote duniani, katika taifa lolote. Watu wote wanaokuzunguka wataona kile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachoweza kufanya. Nitakachofanya pamoja nawe kitawajaza watu hofu kuu.

ko.L: 그러자 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "보아라, 내가 언약을 맺는다. 내가 너의 모든 백성 앞에서 온 땅 어디에서도, 어느 민족 가운데서도 창조된 적이 없는 기이한 일들을 하겠다. 그러면 네가 그 가운데 있는 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 일을 볼 것이다. 내가 너와 함께 하려는 일은 두려운 일이기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "이제 내가 언약을 맺는다. 내가 네 모든 백성 앞에서, 온 땅 어느 민족 가운데서도 일어난 적이 없는 놀라운 일들을 하겠다. 네가 함께 사는 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 하는 일을 볼 것이다. 내가 너와 함께 하려는 일이 그들을 두려움에 떨게 할 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "잘 들어라. 내가 너와 언약을 맺는다. 내가 네 모든 백성 앞에서 놀라운 일들을 하겠다. 그런 일은 세상 어디에서도, 어느 민족에게서도 일어난 적이 없다. 너희 주위에 있는 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 하는 일을 보게 될 것이다. 내가 너희와 함께 하려는 일을 보고 사람들이 두려워 떨 것이다.

vi.L: Ngài phán: "Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập giao ước. Trước mặt toàn dân ngươi, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm những việc kỳ diệu chưa hề được tạo nên trên khắp đất hay trong mọi dân tộc; và toàn dân mà ngươi ở giữa sẽ thấy công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm với ngươi thật đáng kinh sợ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập giao ước. Trước mặt toàn dân của con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm những việc kỳ diệu chưa hề được thực hiện ở bất cứ nơi nào trên đất hay trong bất cứ dân tộc nào. Cả dân mà con đang sống giữa họ sẽ thấy công việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm, vì điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm với con sẽ khiến họ kinh sợ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Hãy nghe đây! Ta lập giao ước với con. Ta sẽ làm những việc lạ lùng trước mặt toàn dân của con. Chưa hề có điều gì như thế được làm ở bất cứ nơi nào trên thế giới, trong bất cứ dân tộc nào. Mọi người chung quanh con sẽ thấy những gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể làm. Điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm với con sẽ khiến người ta kinh sợ.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Eis que eu faço uma aliança. Diante de todo o teu povo farei maravilhas que não foram criadas em toda a terra nem em nação alguma, e todo o povo no meio do qual tu [estás] verá a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois [é] tremendo o que eu faço contigo.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Aqui e agora faço uma aliança. Diante de todo o teu povo realizarei maravilhas como nunca foram criadas em parte alguma da terra nem em nação nenhuma. Todo o povo no meio do qual vives verá o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faz, pois o que vou fazer contigo os encherá de temor.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Escuta! Estou fazendo uma aliança contigo. Vou fazer coisas maravilhosas diante de todo o teu povo. Nada parecido jamais foi feito em lugar nenhum do mundo, em nação nenhuma. Todo o povo ao teu redor vai ver o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} pode fazer. O que vou fazer contigo vai encher as pessoas de temor.

am.L: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ «እነሆ፣ እኔ ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር ሁሉ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ መካከል ያልተፈጠሩ ድንቆችን በሕዝብህ ሁሉ ፊት አደርጋለሁ፤ አንተ በመካከላቸው ያለህበት ሕዝብ ሁሉ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሥራ ያያል፤ ከአንተ ጋር የማደርገው ነገር የሚያስፈራ ነውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለ፦ «አሁን እዚሁ ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ። በምድር ላይ በየትም ስፍራ ወይም በየትኛውም ሕዝብ መካከል ከቶ ያልተፈጠሩ ድንቆችን በሕዝብህ ሁሉ ፊት አደርጋለሁ። በመካከላቸው የምትኖርባቸው ሕዝብ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚያደርገውን ያያሉ፤ ከአንተ ጋር የማደርገው ነገር በፍርሃት ይሞላቸዋልና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ አለ፦ «ስማ! ከአንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ። በሕዝብህ ሁሉ ፊት አስደናቂ ነገሮችን አደርጋለሁ። እንደ እነዚህ ያለ ነገር በዓለም ላይ በየትኛውም ሕዝብ መካከል ተደርጎ አያውቅም። በዙሪያህ ያሉ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምን ማድረግ እንደሚችል ያያሉ። ከአንተ ጋር የማደርገው ነገር ሰዎችን በፍርሃት ይሞላቸዋል።

decisions.choice: created: brought into being by God alone
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in Genesis 1:1, and only God is ever its subject. The wonders will be new acts of God, without precedent (compare Numbers 16:30).

decisions.choice: all the people in whose midst you are: Israel, or the nations around
alternatives: the nations among whom you live
decisions.reason: "You" here is Moses, so "the people in whose midst you are" is most likely Israel itself, among whom Moses lives. It may also mean the peoples around Israel, who will see what God does for them (verse 11).

decisions.choice: awesome: inspiring fear and reverence
decisions.reason: The word describes what fills people with dread and wonder, as God's acts at the sea did (15:11).

decisions.choice: The LORD said
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "he said"; Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: a covenant with you
decisions.reason: Readable adds "with you" from verse 27, where God says he has made a covenant with Moses and with Israel.

decisions.choice: créées (L); créé (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of Genesis 1:1, used only of God (m1), so Literal and Balanced keep "créer"; Readable says "fait", as the English Readable says "done".

decisions.choice: "창조된 적이 없는" (L); "일어난 적이 없는" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for God's creating (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps it, as the English Literal keeps "created".

decisions.choice: tu (God to Moses and Israel in the singular, verses 10-27)
decisions.reason: Through the words of the renewed covenant (verses 10-26) God speaks with a singular "you", to Moses and to Israel as one, so Portuguese uses "tu" at every level, as in the Ten Words of chapter 20: future verbs at Literal and Balanced ("não farás", "guardarás") and the imperative or "deves" at Readable ("Não faças", "Celebra"), as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets for laws. The commands repeated from chapters 20, 23 and 13 keep the wording drafted there where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: שְׁמָ֨ר־לְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּךָ֣ הַיּ֑וֹם הִנְנִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִפָּנֶ֗יךָ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהַחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep for yourself that which I [am] commanding you this day. Here I [am] about to drive out from before you the Amorite[s] and the Canaanite[s] and the Hittite[s] and the Perizzite[s] and the Hivite[s] and the Jebusite[s].

en.L: Keep for yourself what I am commanding you today. Look, I am driving out before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
en.B: Take care to keep what I am commanding you today. Watch: I am about to drive out ahead of you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
en.R: Do what I am telling you today. I am going to force out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites ahead of you.

es.L: Guarda para ti lo que yo te mando hoy. He aquí, yo expulso delante de ti al amorreo y al cananeo y al hitita y al ferezeo y al heveo y al jebuseo.
es.B: Pon cuidado en cumplir lo que hoy te ordeno. Mira: voy a expulsar delante de ti a los amorreos, cananeos, hititas, ferezeos, heveos y jebuseos.
es.R: Haz lo que hoy te digo. Yo iré delante de ti y echaré a los amorreos, los cananeos, los hititas, los ferezeos, los heveos y los jebuseos.

fr.L: Garde pour toi ce que je te commande aujourd’hui. Voici, je chasse devant toi l’Amoréen et le Cananéen et le Hittite et le Phérézien et le Hévien et le Jébusien.
fr.B: Prends garde à observer ce que je te commande aujourd’hui. Regarde : je vais chasser devant toi les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Hittites, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens.
fr.R: Fais ce que je te dis aujourd’hui. Je vais chasser devant toi les Amoréens, les Cananéens, les Hittites, les Phéréziens, les Héviens et les Jébusiens.

sw.L: Shika kwa ajili yako mwenyewe lile ninalokuamuru leo. Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninamfukuza mbele yako Mwamori na Mkanaani na Mhiti na Mperizi na Mhivi na Myebusi.
sw.B: Uwe mwangalifu kushika ninayokuamuru leo. Angalia: ninakaribia kuwafukuza mbele yako Waamori, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
sw.R: Fanya ninayokuambia leo. Nitawafukuza mbele yako Waamori, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.

ko.L: 오늘 내가 너에게 명령하는 것을 너는 지켜라. 보아라, 내가 네 앞에서 아모리 사람과 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 브리스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람을 쫓아내겠다.
ko.B: 오늘 내가 너에게 명령하는 것을 잘 지켜라. 보아라, 내가 네 앞에서 아모리 사람과 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 브리스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람을 쫓아내겠다.
ko.R: 오늘 내가 너에게 말하는 것을 지켜야 한다. 내가 너희보다 앞서 가서 아모리 사람, 가나안 사람, 헷 사람, 브리스 사람, 히위 사람, 여부스 사람을 쫓아내겠다.

vi.L: Hãy giữ cho ngươi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho ngươi hôm nay. Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đuổi khỏi trước mặt ngươi người A-mô-rít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.B: Các ngươi phải cẩn thận giữ điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho các ngươi hôm nay. Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp đuổi khỏi trước mặt các ngươi người A-mô-rít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.R: Hãy làm theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho các ngươi hôm nay. Ta sẽ đuổi người A-mô-rít, người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít ra khỏi xứ trước mặt các ngươi.

pt.L: Guarda para ti o que eu te ordeno hoje. Eis que eu expulso de diante de ti o amorreu, e o cananeu, e o hitita, e o ferezeu, e o heveu, e o jebuseu.
pt.B: Cuida de obedecer ao que hoje te ordeno. Olha: estou para expulsar da tua frente os amorreus, os cananeus, os hititas, os ferezeus, os heveus e os jebuseus.
pt.R: Faze o que hoje te ordeno. Vou expulsar da tua frente os amorreus, os cananeus, os hititas, os ferezeus, os heveus e os jebuseus.

am.L: ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ለራስህ ጠብቅ፤ እነሆ፣ አሞራዊውንና ከነዓናዊውን፣ ኬጢያዊውንና ፌርዛዊውን፣ ኤውያዊውንና ኢያቡሳዊውን ከፊትህ አባርራለሁ።
am.B: ዛሬ የማዝዝህን ለመጠበቅ ተጠንቀቅ። ተመልከት፤ አሞራውያንን፣ ከነዓናውያንን፣ ኬጢያውያንን፣ ፌርዛውያንን፣ ኤውያውያንንና ኢያቡሳውያንን ከፊትህ ላባርራቸው ነው።
am.R: ዛሬ የምነግርህን አድርግ። አሞራውያንን፣ ከነዓናውያንን፣ ኬጢያውያንን፣ ፌርዛውያንን፣ ኤውያውያንንና ኢያቡሳውያንን ከፊትህ አስገድጄ አስወጣቸዋለሁ።

decisions.choice: keep for yourself: take care to obey
decisions.reason: "Keep" means to watch over, and "for yourself" makes it personal: be careful to do it.

decisions.choice: the six peoples of the land
decisions.reason: The same peoples are listed in 3:8, 17, 23:23 and 33:2. They lived in Canaan before Israel.

decisions.choice: Amorites, Canaanites ...
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses singular names for each whole people. Balanced and Readable use plurals; Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (Balanced, Readable) for the singular "you" of the laws in verses 11-26
decisions.reason: These commands are for all Israel, though the Hebrew "you" is singular; Balanced and Readable say "các ngươi", as the Pentateuch terms note does for God's laws, and Literal keeps the singular "ngươi".

source.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ פֶּן־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Take heed to yourself lest you make a covenant with [the] inhabitant[s] of the land which you [are] going to it, lest he become a snare in your midst.

en.L: Take heed to yourself lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land which you are going into, lest it become a snare in your midst.
en.B: Watch yourself, so that you make no covenant with the people living in the land you are entering; otherwise it will become a trap set in your midst.
en.R: Be careful not to make any agreement with the people who live in the land you are going into. If you do, it will be like a trap that catches you.

es.L: Guárdate de hacer pacto con los habitantes de la tierra a la que vas a entrar, no sea que se convierta en una trampa en medio de ti.
es.B: Cuídate de no hacer ningún pacto con los que viven en la tierra en la que entras; de lo contrario, será una trampa tendida en medio de ti.
es.R: Ten cuidado de no hacer ningún acuerdo con la gente que vive en la tierra adonde vas. Si lo haces, será como una trampa que te atrapa.

fr.L: Garde-toi de conclure une alliance avec les habitants du pays où tu vas entrer, de peur que cela ne devienne un piège au milieu de toi.
fr.B: Prends garde à toi : ne conclus aucune alliance avec les habitants du pays où tu entres ; sinon, ce serait un piège tendu au milieu de toi.
fr.R: Fais attention à ne faire aucun accord avec les gens qui habitent le pays où tu vas entrer. Si tu le fais, ce sera comme un piège qui te prendra.

sw.L: Jihadhari nafsi yako, usije ukafanya agano na wenyeji wa nchi unayoiendea, lisije likawa mtego katikati yako.
sw.B: Jilinde, usifanye agano lolote na watu wanaoishi katika nchi unayoingia; vinginevyo litakuwa mtego uliotegwa katikati yako.
sw.R: Uwe mwangalifu usifanye mapatano yoyote na watu wanaoishi katika nchi unayokwenda. Ukifanya hivyo, itakuwa kama mtego utakaokunasa.

ko.L: 너는 스스로 조심하여, 네가 들어가는 땅에 사는 주민과 언약을 맺지 말아라. 그것이 너희 가운데 올무가 될까 염려된다.
ko.B: 너는 조심하여, 네가 들어가는 땅에 사는 사람들과 언약을 맺지 말아라. 그렇지 않으면 그것이 너희 가운데 놓인 올무가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 네가 들어가는 땅에 사는 사람들과 조약을 맺지 않도록 조심해야 한다. 조약을 맺으면 그것이 너희를 걸려 넘어지게 하는 덫이 될 것이다.

vi.L: Hãy giữ lấy mình, kẻo ngươi lập giao ước với dân cư của xứ mà ngươi sắp vào, kẻo nó trở thành cái bẫy ở giữa ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy coi chừng, đừng lập giao ước với dân cư trong xứ các ngươi sắp vào, kẻo điều đó trở thành cái bẫy giăng ra giữa các ngươi.
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận, đừng giao kết gì với dân sống trong xứ các ngươi sắp vào. Nếu các ngươi làm vậy, điều đó sẽ như một cái bẫy bắt lấy các ngươi.

pt.L: Guarda-te para que não faças aliança com os habitantes da terra na qual estás entrando, para que não se torne um laço no meio de ti.
pt.B: Toma cuidado para não fazer aliança com os que habitam a terra em que estás entrando; do contrário, ela se tornará uma armadilha no meio de ti.
pt.R: Toma cuidado para não fazer nenhum acordo com o povo que vive na terra para onde estás indo. Se fizeres isso, esse acordo será como uma armadilha que te prende.

am.L: ወደምትገባባት ምድር ከሚኖሩት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እንዳታደርግ ለራስህ ተጠንቀቅ፤ በመካከልህ ወጥመድ እንዳይሆን።
am.B: ወደምትገባባት ምድር ከሚኖሩት ሕዝብ ጋር ምንም ቃል ኪዳን እንዳታደርግ ራስህን ጠብቅ፤ አለዚያ በመካከልህ የተዘረጋ ወጥመድ ይሆንብሃል።
am.R: ወደምትገባባት ምድር ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ምንም ዓይነት ስምምነት እንዳታደርግ ተጠንቀቅ። ይህን ብታደርግ እንደሚይዝህ ወጥመድ ይሆንብሃል።

decisions.choice: snare: a trap that lures and catches
decisions.reason: A snare is a bird trap. A covenant with the peoples of the land would draw Israel into worshiping their gods (23:33; Judges 2:3).

decisions.choice: lest it become: the covenant, or the people
decisions.reason: The verb is singular. It may refer to the covenant, or to the inhabitants of the land taken together as one; in 23:33 it is their gods that would be a snare. The sense is the same: the tie would trap Israel.

decisions.choice: agreement
decisions.reason: The same word as God's covenant in verse 10. Here it is a treaty between peoples, so Readable says "agreement"; Literal and Balanced keep "covenant" to show the contrast with God's covenant.

decisions.choice: God's laws to Moses in the singular "너", with "너희" where the Hebrew turns to the people
decisions.reason: In 34:10-26 God speaks to Moses but the commands are for all Israel.
